name: a ring completes into a calm reassurance
looks: A thin ring draws itself closed at the centre of an otherwise empty dark frame, in a calm accent colour, and settles whole just as a quiet caption fades up beneath it confirming everything is in order.
build: radial-progress-anticipation's ring, used as a simple completion mark rather than a percentage counter: the stroke draws with strokeDashoffset to a full closed circle on power2.out, with no counter text; the caption fades in right as it closes.
sound: A soft rising tone that resolves into a calm chime as the ring closes.
prompt: On an otherwise empty frame, draw a thin ring closed in one calm accent colour, with no counter or label, and let a short reassuring caption fade up right as it completes. Use it as a quiet, wordless "all done" beat between busier data scenes.
